reviews.text:
Thank you so much for your wonderful service and kind care! We truly appreciate your kindness in accommodating us without an appointment and going out of your way to help us. The complimentary service was such a thoughtful and generous gesture, and it really meant a lot to us.
We’re so grateful for your kindness and excellent service. We’ll definitely be back next week to get Maple’s nail fixed! 😊🐾
Thank you again for being so kind and caring!

I’ve been coming to From Street Animal Hospital for over five years and have always had a great experience. The staff are friendly, professional, and genuinely care about the animals they look after. A special shoutout to Dr. Morel, who consistently goes above and beyond for my dog and always makes every visit such a breeze. Couldn’t recommend them enough!

Horrific experience - left me in tears for multiple days - DO NOT go here if you care for your pet at all.

We brought our family dog to Front Street after he was attacked and bitten by another dog. The vet examined the wound, determined he had two puncture wounds, flushed it, and sent us home within about five minutes. No antibiotics were prescribed, and the area was not shaved to properly assess the extent of the wounds.

A week later, our dog’s face was severely infected and had developed a large abscess. We took him to a 24/7 emergency clinic (PetNation), where we were told that the area should have been shaved initially to identify all of the wounds and that antibiotics should have been given from the start based on the nature of the attack.

Our sweet dog ultimately had to be sedated and undergo a procedure to properly drain the abscess .. a significantly more serious situation than what we originally brought him in for and something that could have completely been avoided if Front Street Animal Hospital hadn't been negligent in the care provided to him.

Thankfully, PetNation took over his care and we cannot recommend them enough. They provided the level of care we expected from a veterinary clinic in the first place and helped get our dog through what had become a much more serious infection.

I am absolutely disgusted by our experience at Front Street. We brought our dog in after a traumatic attack expecting him to be properly examined and treated by professionals because this was the first time anything like this has ever happened to him and we didn't know the appropriate treatment to expect in this case. To be duped by professionals who are out to make a quick buck against the most precious of souls and don't actually care about providing quality treatment is so painful to go through as a pet owner and I am so mad that we trusted them.

What is equally unacceptable is how this clinic handles communication. When questioned about this, they refuse to respond to emails and insist on communicating by phone, leaving no written record of conversations about your pet’s care.

For something as serious as a veterinary treatment error, that is completely unacceptable. I would never trust Front Street with my dog again, and I strongly recommend that other pet owners think twice before putting their animal in their care. We will never be returning.

EDIT to owners response: we did reach out to you and you did nothing so not sure what the point of responding / commenting back to me was? No need to make yourself look like you're being collaborative, helpful, or responsible in a public forum - means nothing to anyone

Borderline NEGLIGENCE… DO NOT GO HERE !

My sister and wife brought our family dog in after a dog attack/bite. The vet looked at the wound, flushed it, and sent us home within five minutes. A week later his face was badly infected with a large abscess. A 24/7 clinic told us Front Street should have shaved the area to find all wounds and prescribed antibiotics up front. They did neither, took my money, and sent us home with a much bigger problem.
The next day I called to understand the reasoning behind the treatment, and partway through the call the vet apologized and accepted responsibility.
My dog had to be sedated and operated on so the abscess could drain properly. PetNation handled that work, and I highly recommend them. Far better care, and I wouldn't waste money on a private-equity-run clinic like Front Street. They also don't respond to emails and insist on phone calls, so nothing is documented.
Great experience overall. The staff were friendly, professional, and took great care of my cat.

They put steroid drops in my cat's eye without doing the basic dye test that checks for a scratch first. Steroids on a scratched eye can stop it from healing and, in a cat with herpes (already noted on her file), can cost the eye. The vet herself said there might be a scratch. Still no test, still steroids. The kitty was very stressed during and after the appointment, had appetite issues and went to the emergency.

Same visit: a long-lasting steroid injection for a swollen lip with zero tests to find out why. Cause given: "probably the air".

A better clinic ran bloodwork, found the real problem, and started proper treatment. Got way better and cheaper service...

They also signed me up for their Pet Health Club and told me I could cancel before October at no cost. I asked multiple times, including 'even if I cancel next week?', and got 'yes, all good' every time. False. They are now demanding money for what I clarified multiple times was discounted with nothing to pay back.

Just moved for school and needed to find a local vet for our senior cat, front street animal hospital was lovely, everyone was kind, incredibly helpful and knowledgeable and they quickly were able to order in the specialty food needed for our cat.

I was nervous to make the transition as we had been with our prior vet for years and our cat has some existing medical issues.  When I spoke with them over the phone they let me know they were able to request her paperwork from our vet and informed me of all the charges before booking our introductory appointment and taking us on as clients.  I appreciated the transparency and quick introductory appointment.

Very happy with our choice to go to Front Street Animal Hospital!  Thanks for making this transition easy for Nibs and giving her great care!
Great service
Dr. Illiana is an amazing veterinarian! She is thorough, kind and compassionate. The reception staff are also incredible and very nice. Thanks to the team for taking care of Athena!

I've been taking my dog to Front Street Animal Hospital for over 4 years now, and they have always been super attentive not only to him, but to me as well.
The care is definitely excellent, but what I appreciate the most is the patience to answer questions, discuss concerns I have about my little guy, and provide guidance.
I'm very happy having them as my dog veterinarians!.

Front St Animal Hospital always takes such great care of Milo. The staff are consistently so kind, caring, and friendly, and we always feel like he’s in good hands. Really appreciate the care they provide!

Friendly and knowledgeable staff.  Everyone from the front desk staff, to the techs and vets, is super helpful.  They’re very thorough with exams and tests, explain everything clearly, and really care about helping the pets.

EDIT: Charged me just to tell me what I've already been told few months back by previous owner of clinic. During initial check up they barley move a muscle and call it a check up leaving out other areas of the dogs health.

Previous owner quoted me $1200 and now the new young doctor wants $3.5k and claims that xrays don't show the true health of the teeth and it will cost more because they need to inspect each teeth?

I think new ownership has made this place worse.

Won't be returning.
Great team and staff. They always take such good care of our babies Paco & Jaxxx.

I had my little Bella at Front Street Animal Hospital for almost 16 years. I am returning with my new friend Luna because I had such a great experience. The vets are very caring and personable and they don’t overcharge. They’re very fair and warm and caring. I would recommend them to anyone - and I have!

Dr. Illiana has been incredibly attentive, compassionate, and dedicated. My Boston Terrier was diagnosed with lymphangiectasia by our previous vet, but it wasn’t until we began following Dr. Illiana’s treatment plan that we saw a remarkable improvement. Her thoughtful approach to managing his medications helped Milo feel like his old self again.

She always takes the time to listen to our concerns, explains everything clearly, and genuinely cares about Milo’s quality of life. It’s such a relief to have a vet who is both knowledgeable and compassionate. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.

We have been going to this vet clinic for over 6 years now and always get extraordinary services. They have been able to help us quickly during emergencies and we always know our cat will be in great hands with the staff here. Highly recommend them!
We and our pet love this vet Clinic. All the staff and vets are super friendly and nice! Plus being part of the clinic club gave us a super rebate on the annual check up!

Firstly, we did a dental with them and it wasn’t until after the $3000+ procedure that I learned they only pulled my dog’s teeth, they did NOT clean them! I have had dogs for years and never experienced a dental where they didn’t clean them. I’ve now learned at my new vet that my aging dog needs ANOTHER dental as a result to clean her teeth only 2 years later.

And secondly, I’ve finally decided to move vets after our last visit. We waited for over an hour for our appointment. When we were finally called in, the vet (I can name names if needed) was in a potentially clinically manic state. She was EXTREMELY convoluted in explaining things, she kept using completely unrelated and confusing metaphors to explain things that were actually simple to understand in their original form. She kept changing subjects and not answering my questions clearly, and could not stay on task at all. We were there to assess a lump and when I wrenched her back on task over and over, she said she’d send me a quote afterwards for different treatment approaches. When I went to get my jacket, it had fallen from the chair to the ground into some urine… they didn’t clean the room since the visit before us. Finally, it took 4 follow up emails from me over a few weeks to finally get the quote.

This led to me realizing I cannot trust this practice. I will never come back here and I would warn others against it.

I miss the original vet, he was lovely. Since it was sold to a holding company, it’s a disaster.

What a fabulous experience from start to finish. My dog needed a hard to obtain vaccine to travel to Australia and I was very fortunate to find this clinic with a supply. They understood the requirements and booked to appointment quickly. It was the first time my dog had appeared so comfortable in a clinic environment since I got her three years ago. Staff and the vet (Dr Morel) were first class all the way 💯 🐾🙏
Not only is this veterinary clinic close to my house. They are the sweetest people. I am very much an overbearing cat Mom and they understand and are very compassionate.
We’re incredibly thankful for your outstanding 5-star feedback! It’s wonderful to know we met your expectations. Your support means everything to us, and we truly value your trust.
Cleo approves

My little princess has been coming here her whole entire life, and I cannot recommend them enough. The staff are always so incredibly friendly, and the management team is super kind and understanding.
​Recently, I had some trouble with my dog's medication, and they went completely above and beyond to help me get them replaced. While we were waiting for the new shipment to come in, they even provided us with safe alternatives to use in the meantime so she wouldn't miss a beat. They always know exactly how to put my mind at ease whenever I have concerns about my little girl. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of us!

I have poured my trust, my loyalty, and my hard-earned money into Front Street Vet for years. I never batted an eye at their premium rates because I truly believed I was paying for the absolute best care for my fur babies.

But recently, my world was shattered when one of my dogs received a bad diagnosis. Terrified and desperate, I turned to the one place I thought would be my safety net. I just wanted a second opinion from the "trusted" hands that have known my dogs for years. Getting an appointment for a critical, time-sensitive crisis should be a given, right?

Instead, I was told the next available opening is ten days away.

Ten days. I felt my stomach drop. I can’t sleep, I can't breathe, and my dog absolutely cannot wait that long. To make a heartbreaking situation even worse, they casually mentioned their X-ray machine is broken. No explanation on when it will be fixed, no urgency. If you are drowning in appointments, why aren't you hiring more vets?

Ever since Dr. Barrientos retired, the soul of this clinic has completely vanished. It has turned into a cold, corporate machine. I am utterly heartbroken and feel completely abandoned by a business I genuinely believed put my dogs' lives above profit. When we needed them most, they slammed the door.
Great staff, both techs and vets. Jake was well taken care of by Dr. Morel on our recent visit. The doctor was very caring and informative. Thanks F.S.A.H.
Super friendly and informative. As a first time dog owner, it was very reassuring in how supportive they were.
Everyone I interacted with here was super nice and very helpful. Dr Chung was awesome!
I paid $450 for my dog’s vaccines, but they missed one. When I returned, they ended up giving him a vaccine he didn’t even need.

I am sharing this review so other pet owners understand my experience before scheduling surgery at this clinic.

My dog was booked for a dental procedure after it was recommended by the veterinarian. My husband and I arranged our schedules carefully. I worked from home and my husband cancelled work travel to be present because any surgery involving a pet is stressful.

Unfortunately, communication from the clinic was inconsistent from the start. When I initially called with questions, staff were unable to provide answers and promised a follow up that never happened. After several attempts to reach the clinic, we received only an automated preparation email two days before surgery.

At 5:45 PM the evening before surgery, I was contacted and asked to consider rescheduling due to an emergency case. While emergencies are understandable, this request came after significant planning on our end. During that same call, I was asked to immediately pick up a sedative medication even though the clinic was closing in 15 minutes and I was working outside Toronto, making it impossible to comply.

On the morning of surgery, I learned no pre operative bloodwork had been completed and that a different veterinarian would be handling the procedure without prior notice. We left our 4 kg dog at the clinic at 9 AM expecting clear communication throughout the day.

After receiving no updates, I called at approximately 2:30 PM and was told the surgery could not proceed because my dog was “not responding to local anesthesia.” Only after I explained that rescheduling would be extremely difficult did the doctor indicate the procedure could proceed after all. This reactive communication and lack of transparency was deeply concerning.

Despite these issues, I made the decision to reschedule, hoping for a smoother experience. Unfortunately, the situation worsened. After following their instructions and administering anti anxiety medication to prepare my dog for surgery, I was informed the night before the rescheduled procedure that the clinic needed to cancel again, stating they did not have appropriate staff available to administer anesthesia.

This sequence of events reflects serious concerns with scheduling coordination, communication, and procedural readiness. Pet owners place enormous trust in veterinary clinics, and clear, proactive communication should be the minimum standard.

Given the seriousness of this experience, I am also filing a formal complaint with the Better Business Bureau so this matter is properly reviewed.

I hope clinic leadership takes this feedback seriously and makes the necessary improvements to prevent similar situations for other clients.
Simba’s visit was very pleasant, he was well behaved and the doctor was very friendly and informative.
Terrible experience. Extremely disappointed by management and the lack of customer service they showed.
Great Vet. Very quick and responsive. No issue.
I accepted the nurse to take my dog to a different room for vaccination however I think it would have been better if vaccines are applied where I can be with my dog
We took are kitten here and had a great experience overall. The doctor took great care of our kitten. The staff were very kind.

Been with this clinic since 2019. Used to be prompt, courteous and with transparent pricing. The past year or so, service quality severely downgraded. It takes over a week for a response to email inquiries. Dental extractions also are not thorough—my cat has to have another dental operation not even 6 months later.

I also have to cancel my online orders because they took too long for the clinic to validate my prescription food. Trying to avoid VetStrategy clinics from now on if this is the norm (though it’s hard as they’re everywhere.)

I really hope they start to improve, I have so much history with this clinic.
Love Dr. Iliana Morel’s wise, soothing approach and this down to earth clinic. Highly recommended.
Great!

Choosing a vet it’s such a heart decision but after seven wonderful years with Front Street Animal Hospital, we can’t recommend them enough! The team is so kind and professional they treat our lovely pet like their own. We trust them completely. Thank you team! Mel & Milu

The staff are friendly and supportive.  Love the Vets. So glad a friend referred me here

Similar to another reviewer I am feeling a steady decline and lack of clarity. I understand they are short staffed but they are also advertising for new patients.

My last visit in to get blood test so my cats thyroid medicine could be renewed I was asked what kind of blood test. Stunned me as I am not the vet and did had no idea. Ultimately a vet came out realized my cat had not been weighed got her weighed  and confirmed the type of blood test.

Recently I had a similar confusion over latest blood test and prescription refill.

I am not clear what is going wrong but really disappointed.

I had blood work done for my dog on Friday and was supposed to receive the results on Monday. I called on Tuesday and was told by the receptionist that the doctor is busy and will call you regarding the results later in the evening. No call.
I called on Thursday morning and asked them to email me the results as it seemed like the doctor was still busy … no email
I called again on Thursday evening and they finally emailed me the results… 6 days to get results.
The doctor did not bother or neither did the team bother to give me a courtesy call or email saying results are not critical and the doctor will call when they can…
Now I am going to have to pay more money to have these results reviewed by another doctor at another clinic as this team has way too much to handle and cannot accommodate more pets.
Saw Dr Malik this time I think she’s a new addition to the clinic and was very kind and helpful!

I had a great experience at my recent appointment with my cat, Agathe. Dr. Chung was incredibly kind, attentive, and helpful throughout the visit. She took the time to listen to my concerns, explain everything clearly, and made sure Agathe was as comfortable as possible. It’s always reassuring to feel that your pet is in caring and capable hands. I really appreciated her patience and professionalism. Thank you, Dr. Chung!

First time visiting this clinic with my cat. The staff were very kind, caring, and professional. The appointment was efficient and they explained everything clearly. Overall a really good experience. Would definitely recommend.

Up until recently I was quite happy with Front Street Animal Hospital. The care team was always kind and the veterinarians seemed knowledgeable, so this experience was disappointing.

About a month ago I called to request a prescription refill for my cat’s asthma medication. She has had this diagnosis for several years. At first I was told I needed to bring her in for an exam because they had not made the original diagnosis. I questioned this since the clinic already has her full records from my previous veterinarian. After the receptionist spoke with the vet, I was told they would refill the prescription but that it would take a few weeks because they had to order it.

Yesterday when I called to check on the refill, there was apparently no record of that conversation in my file. I was again told that I needed to bring my cat in for an exam. When I explained that the clinic had already agreed to refill the prescription, the supervisor dismissed that information and said it was “protocol” and that an exam was required.

I understand that clinics have policies and legal requirements. However, it was frustrating to be told one thing and then have that agreement completely disregarded. In a time when veterinary care is already extremely expensive and many people are struggling with the cost of living, being asked to pay for an unnecessary exam for a long standing condition felt very disappointing.

I had previously trusted this clinic, but this experience left me feeling unheard and frustrated.
Great vets and great staff. Been taking my cat here for years.

We have been with Front Street Animal Hospital for the last six years. Our dog, Chip, is always excited to go (even when that means shots) due to the attention and treats. Thank you for making “the vet” not a stress trigger, but associated with treats and some cute pictures.

I was told it would be 45$ on the phone when I asked about an appointment to get my dogs anal glands expressed then charged 90$ they said they made a mistake over the phone with the pricing and it was 90$
Should not have quoted me 45$ then
Dr. Jordan and the FrontStreetVet team are amazing! They took care of my older cat with so much kind and respect.

Thank you for the 5-star rating!
We truly appreciate your support. We look forward to serving you again!

Although the vets are good, the receptionists are rude and unorganized. They don’t even say hello or acknowledge you. Even if you’re busy, just a polite “one moment please” would suffice. They forgot things, had people waiting for so long, and at one point I was at the desk and they just called up someone else as a way to dismiss me. No goodbye either. Pet owners are usually already nervous for their fur babies at the vet, we don’t need rudeness on top of that.

TLDR: Disregard the safety of your pet and the sanctity of veterinary care in order to make some quick cash.

Brought my cat (Male 5) here for his annual check up in December of 2025. All was well, couldn't get a full look into mouth as he was feeling a little feisty (he has anxiety). Was told that there was a bit of plaque build up and to try out this type of food specifically to help keep teeth clean. Got his shots and off we went with sample in hand of food.

This brings me to present day... where (two months later) I randomly receive an email with an estimate ~ 4K for serious dental work including tooth extraction which anesthesia would be needed for my cat. I called the clinic immediately as this was surely a mistake.

To my surprise, no not a mistake but not to worry as they have a dental promotion starting next week where I'd be able to receive 15% off any dental work. Wow talk about timing!

I explained that none of the above, especially an extraction, was ever mentioned during that last visit (contradictory to their 'notes'). So please tell me why we would even receive this quote 2 months later...

So I will be taking my cat elsewhere as unnecessary procedures where my cat would be put under are a big NO for me. Putting animals at risk and removing teeth for some quick cash is not only unethical but emotionally sickening.
Received amazing care for my dog and found the team to be very friendly.   I wish I had found this veterinary hospital 5 years ago.   Highly recommend this place for animal care.

I've consistently had great experiences with the team at Front St Animal Hospital! They've provided great care for my dog and cat. The team is knowledgeable, prompt with communication, and has helped schedule short notice appointments when needed. Highly recommend!
Very friendly and knowledgeable staff.
Been using them for years for multiple cats, no complaints.

I contacted Front Street Animal Hospital specifically looking for a nutritionist, not a general vet, as I already have a veterinarian at Yonge & St. Clair. My 3yo Chihuahua is overweight and I wanted structured support: goal setting, accountability, and regular check-ins — not just being told what kibble to buy. I clearly explained this during my first phone call.

At the appointment, I met with a very young veterinarian who mainly discussed which kibble to use and initially set my dog’s calorie intake to 173 calories per day. There was no plan, no follow-up structure, and no accountability, which was exactly what I said I was trying to avoid. It felt no different from my previous experience elsewhere.

When I asked practical questions — for example, whether it was appropriate to suddenly drop from a larger daily intake to 173 calories and whether my dog might feel excessively hungry — the answers felt very approximate and uncertain (e.g., “maybe we can start from… 200?”). This did not inspire confidence in the guidance being provided.

The consultation lasted about 30–40 minutes and cost $170, which I was not informed about in advance. The food was not included and had to be ordered separately.

For comparison, my regular clinic charged $60 for a similar consultation and provided a 5kg bag of kibble plus an additional bag of treats at NO CHARGE.

Clear pricing and scope should have been communicated upfront. Based on what was delivered, the cost felt disproportionate to the value and did not align with what I requested.

If you’re specifically looking for a structured weight-loss program or nutrition accountability, I recommend clarifying exactly what services you’ll receive and the full cost before booking.

I cannot recommend the team at Front Street Animal Hospital highly enough. When it comes to my pup’s health, I put 100% of my trust into this team, and they have never let me down.
Whether I’m calling for quick advice over the phone or coming in for a thorough annual exam, they consistently go above and beyond. One of the things I appreciate most is their honesty; they always inform me of best practices and medical recommendations without ever trying to upsell me. It is clear that their primary focus is the well-being of the animals.
The entire staff is incredibly professional, sweet, and a genuine delight to deal with. Even the administrative side is seamless—whenever I order my dog’s food, they communicate with total accuracy regarding when it will arrive.
I would never take my pup anywhere else. If you are looking for a team that is knowledgeable, communicative, and truly cares, Front Street Animal Hospital is the place to go!

Called and was immediately put on hold for ten minutes. Hung up and called again, and the front desk lady was SUPER rude and disrespectful. My boyfriends dog is sick and all I wanted to know was if I should bring him in or not or if this is an emergency. A simple yes or no would have done the trick instead of attitude.
Dr. Tubby was kind and patient with my foster dog, Q-Tip, and we appreciate his time and knowledge. Thank you Dr. Tubby!!
The entire staff are very friendly , knowledgeable and competent!!
Corporate owned clinic.

After going to numerous vets, I can say this one is my favourite. Everyone here is incredibly helpful, friendly, and provides valuable insight. Overall, it's such an easy process from appointment booking to follow-up. Above ground, covered green P is right behind the unit for those who intend to drive. Highly recommend.
Live how cooperative they were, worked to understand my pet’s needs and made my pets and my first visit a breeze.

I’ve been visiting this clinic for several years and though they seemed nice in the beginning, ultimately they don’t follow through on expectations they themselves set. I’ve been told multiple times they’ll call on a certain day and they never do. On top of issues with their in-person services they’ve been a complete nightmare to deal with regarding their third party online store front (even though they’re listed as the contact for those orders). And this is just a personal pet peeve but they are in fact NOT wheelchair accessible. They should not have that mark beside their business. No place is perfect, but I’d rate this as below average for competency and communication between staff.

We have been coming to Front Street Animal Hospital for years and had another great experience. Dr. Morel did a thorough examination and explained things well for us to understand. We were in and out with comfort and ease.
Saw Dr.Kimball for my 2 cats and had a lovely experience! All staff is very friendly and patient

Our dog hates the vet. This has been the best place we bring our dogs. Our last visit we did three shots without any squirming.
She’s a reactive dog and we’re so happy. We have a vet take her in get her shots.

Front Street Animal Hospital is my favourite vet clinic ever. They’ve been incredibly helpful, so empathetic, and they give amazing advice. They’ve been sensitive to budgets, honest with their advice, and patient when I’m freaking out. I am very grateful for their care!!! this old lady says thank you too.

Have been taking my cat to FSAH for nearly 7 years now and they have been great with him. Looking forward to another 7 at least.

edit: 12 years now, still great 👍😺
Have been bringing my cat Dexter to FSH for nearly 15 years now - they've looked after him his whole life and he's still spry despite his age. Could not ask for a nicer set of people.
Amazing staff. I have a dog that doesn’t do well with other dogs and they ensure everyone feels comfortable which makes going to the vet so much more bearable!
Thank you so much

Nice conveniently located city practice. Very responsive, great communication. Well run during the pandemic too. My 2 cats are receiving great care.  Update 2025. One kitty passed away, and my other kitty is now very senior, with a list of chronic conditions.  She is getting consistent progressive care to help her live her best senior life. We are always presented with relevant and current options and comprehensive information to help us make decisions on treatment
Thats my go to Vet in Toronto , good price and good services always .
Have been going to Front Street Animal Hospital for a few year and have had great experiences. Dr. Morel is so caring and really takes the time to answer questions!

So my pet was alot more sick than I originally thought the staff were extremely compassionate, understanding and explained all of my options its been 2 weeks and my cat is doing amazing. I truly believe if I hadn't have gone in for my emergency surgery I would be instead paying for an urn.
Thank you so much.

Thank you for the 5-star rating!
We truly appreciate your support. We look forward to serving you again!

People and pets deserve better care than this clinic has the capacity to give. They feel over booked and under staffed. Please be aware this is a VetStrategy clinic.

I was a client here and called for an urgent care appointment for my pet. It went to voicemail and wasn't returned for 4 hours at which point they confirmed my issue sounded urgent, but they were fully booked for 2 weeks and I should "go somewhere else". Not even an offer or recommendation to find help elsewhere. I've never experienced a clinic that wasn't able to accomodate urgent care within 24-48 hours.

That became the last 2 weeks of my pet's life, and I had to worry about finding a new vet. And while it may not have changed the outcome, it felt cruel.

One of the new clinics I saw in the weeks following was Juno. While I think they might be a little pricier, they showed an incredible amount of kindness and compassion. They were professional, thorough, and helpful through everything, even rearranging schedules to accommodate when needed. I would highly recommend to anyone.
They gave my two young doggos, Raven and Mulder, the best treatment I could have asked for when going in for a checkup on them!  I was amazed how comfortable my pups felt with them immediately!

Thank you for the 5-star rating!
We truly appreciate your support. We look forward to serving you again!

Thank you for the 5-star rating!
We truly appreciate your support. We look forward to serving you again!

Front Street Veterinary Clinic was incredible. They were able to get me in right away, and the vet we saw – Jamie – was amazing. I genuinely felt heard, which made me feel like my dog was truly cared for too. Jamie helped me navigate everything without making me feel like I was just bleeding money. I’ll definitely be asking for Jamie by name next time we go back. Highly recommend!

We visited Front Street clinic on 12/04/2025. Everything went smoothly. Also I was notified about available time slot prior to booked appointment. Doctor was very nice and careful with my small dog, did all procedures carefully (blood sampling). We were assigned for the dental surgery, hope everything will go well. Thanks!
Hi Fernanda! Thank you very much for your 5-star rating! Please give sweet Lola a big big hug from us! 🤗 Johanna, Front Street AH …
Very attentive!
Everytime I go we have a great visit, everyone working here is super nice and attentive to clients.
Staff was extremely helpful, knowledgeable and friendly! My dog especially appreciated all of the hugs and treats.
They're great, they treat and understand animals very well, and they're also kind and pleasant people. Going to the vet with your pets is never a pleasant experience, but they make it much easier.
Great experience so far. We took our kitten there for  vaccines and checkups. Staff and doctors are super friendly and professional. Would definitely recommend!

We absolutely love Front Street Animal Hospital. The staff are always extremely friendly, excited to see our pup and take great care of her while she's in their care. She loves going to the vet so much that she tries to stop in when we're walking by on days they're closed for business ! A fur-ever customer!
Thank you so much for your review :)  We couldn't be happier to help you care for Saba. We look forward to seeing you again soon!
I highly recommend Front Street Animal Hospital, especially working with Dr.Jordy and Dr.Morel. And the staff (Javona💜 and team) are all extremely fabulous to interact with and most helpful …

This review and note are long overdue!!!
Front Street Animal Hospital has been outstanding throughout our journey with Louis.
The team consistently demonstrated kindness, compassion, and genuine care for him at every visit.
When Louis passed, their thoughtful messages and empathy brought our family great comfort.
Their service has always been exceptional — professional, prompt, and delivered with heartfelt attention.

Thank you for all you did with our Louis !!
They’ve taken great care of both my pups for years, thank you front street vets!
Always so attentive to our pup. Answers all our questions and the vet to the receptionist are so caring

The folks at Front Street Animal Hospital are friendly, patient and knowledgeable. I feel completely confident putting my senior cat in their care. They're also really good about explaining procedures and options and costs, giving me the information I need to make the right decisions for my little guy.

Lovely and easy experience here! We arrived early and they were able to see us almost right away with minimal wait time, which was nice because my cat was very nervous. They were very sweet to my little kitty and were very honest about what she needed and what didn’t, no upcharging! I appreciate that. Dr. Gliklich - I only met him once and it was an average interaction, he didn't really provide any information that was useful or maybe I caught him on a bad day but it's not fair to get varying levels of treatment/assistance when you're paying a hefty amount for a vet fee. It also seems that he's a new vet.

Javona - I dislike corresponding with her the most, I think she hates her job.

Kim - Kim is quick and approachable! She knows her stuff.

Kelly - Kelly is friendly and super nice, I enjoy going into the clinic when she's there!

Kris - I went to Front Street initially because it was close to me but after working with Kris, she is 90% the reason why I go to Front Street now. I hope she doesn't go elsewhere and I truly hope that she's around for my dogs to grow old!

My cat was a patient here. After dental surgery, she developed an infection which resulted in two emergency hospital visits (a different hospital) and ultimately having to put her to sleep.

I understand that infection can be a surgery complication. What I take issue with, is the absolute lack of aftercare or check-ins I received after the surgery and her death.

After the surgery, at no point did the clinic reach out to me to check in on my cat. It is standard procedure to give the client a call the day after surgery, and a few days after. Not a single individual at Front Street Animal hospital reached out to me. In fact, I had to reach out to ask clarifying questions regarding her medications, and had to wait until the next day for an answer. When I detailed this to the emergency vet and vet techs, they were APPALLED by the lack of aftercare.

Next, I reached out to let them know my cat wasn't feeling well post-surgery. I scheduled an appointment, then cancelled it because I ended up taking my cat to the ER that same night. In my email requesting to cancel the appointment, I stated that i'm cancelling it because i'm taking her to the ER. Despite the clinic having this information, no one checked in to follow what is happening with her case.

The ER sent the case notes back to Front Street Animal hospital, so her family vet can review and follow-up. No one followed up. Not a single phone call, voicemail, email - nothing. Zero.

Two days after the initial ER visit, I was back in the ER with her condition worsening, and ultimately had to put her to sleep. Again, her family vet received this update. STILL - to this day - over a month later - NOBODY has reached out. A cat that was under your care died of post surgery complications, a surgery performed at YOUR clinic, and the clinic does not have the decency to reach out? I am beyond appalled.

I do not know what went wrong, and can accept that infections can happen, however I do not accept the lack of care and attention her case received. I also do not know why she wasn't given an antibiotic to take after the surgery. I understand she received an antibiotic during, but her medication routine after surgery did not have an antibiotic. This is a senior cat. I can't help but feel this was avoidable.

I am specifically calling out her vet Dr Jordan Gliklich - who was supposed to follow up post-surgery, and who received a call from the emergency vet informing him of Celine's condition and planned euthanasia. Despite all that, he still did not reach out to me (to this day, over a month later).

I would never, EVER recommend relying on this clinic for your beloved pet's care. Ever.

Edit: Thank you for your response. I want to make it clear that I was only contacted over a month after the surgery and my cat's passing. I spoke once with Dr Kimball, and she was empathetic and kind. I also spoke once with Brittaney, and I deeply appreciate how she is managing the situation. Dr. Gliklich received the call from the emergency clinic informing him of the plan to euthanize my cat, so I do expect him to have followed up since my cat was also under his care.
